description: Constituent office visits and governor emergency briefings.

slots.disaster: The incident named in the emergency offer.
slots.deadline: The day the emergency offer expires.
slots.agency: The office responsible for the recorded case.
slots.employer: The employer named in the constituent’s layoff record.
slots.since: Time since the constituent’s recorded layoff.
slots.money-left: How the case describes the constituent’s remaining savings.
slots.staffer: A serving aide named in the official’s staff record.
slots.name: The constituent named in the case.
